purpose: Raw source datasets for building a Greek NT lemma frequency list for the ru2agr_reading app

sources.name: SBL Greek New Testament
sources.primary_use_for_project: Canonical Greek NT text source for cross-reference
sources.recommended_role: Text baseline — compare against other sources
sources.notes: Raw SBLGNT text in XML only. No lemma/morphology/Strong. Use MACULA or MorphGNT for word-level annotation.

sources.name: MACULA Greek Linguistic Datasets
sources.primary_use_for_project: PRIMARY: lemma frequency, form frequency, morphology, Strong, gloss
sources.recommended_role: Primary production source for frequency dictionary
sources.notes: Best-structured, richest single source. SBLGNT TSV has lemma, normalized form, morphology (Robinson), Strong, gloss, semantic domain. PRIMARY CANDIDATE for frequency builder.

sources.name: MorphGNT SBLGNT
sources.license_detected: SBLGNT text: SBLGNT EUL; Morphology/lemmatization: CC-BY-SA
sources.primary_use_for_project: Verification/cross-check of lemma frequencies from MACULA
sources.recommended_role: Verification corpus — do NOT use as primary due to CC-BY-SA
sources.notes: CC-BY-SA on lemmatization is a potential blocker for commercial/proprietary use. Safer to use only for cross-checking MACULA-derived frequencies.

sources.name: Core GNT Vocab (James Tauber)
sources.license_detected: No explicit license (likely inherits CC-BY-SA from MorphGNT)
sources.primary_use_for_project: Baseline frequency lists for sanity-check; slider breakpoints (50/80/90/95%)
sources.recommended_role: Reference baseline — verify own calculations against these
sources.notes: Ready-made coverage thresholds. ~30 lemmas=50%, ~170=80%, ~1,100=95%. Glosses from Dodson. Use as reference, recalculate from MACULA for production.

sources.name: STEPBible Data (Tyndale House)
sources.license_detected: CONFLICT: README says CC BY 4.0; historical pages say CC BY-NC 3.0; file headers mixed
sources.primary_use_for_project: TBESG gloss reference; morphology code documentation (TEGMC)
sources.recommended_role: Supplementary gloss source — TBESG lexicon for Strong→gloss mapping
sources.notes: Richest annotation but messiest license. TBESG is the best single gloss source. Use for reference, not production data.

sources.name: Open Greek New Testament Project
sources.license_detected: Public license (exact terms unclear); aggregates CC BY / CC BY-SA / other data
sources.recommended_role: Comparison and enrichment — transliterations, multiple gloss levels
sources.notes: Well-documented but complex license heritage. Best used for cross-validation and supplementary features (SBL transliteration, multi-level glosses).

disclaimer: ENGINEERING ASSESSMENT ONLY — NOT LEGAL ADVICE. All license determinations are preliminary. Human legal review is required before using any source in production, especially for commercial use. Attribution requirements must be verified independently.
